change.title: chore: merge dev with updater recovery fix into main
change.description: ## Summary Merge dev branch yang sudah include fix untuk updater recovery (PR #93) ke main untuk tag v0.3.4. ### Context - PR #93 memperbaiki auto-update yang gagal karena latest.json tidak ada di release v0.3.3 - Diperlukan tag baru v0.3.4 untuk menggantikan v0.3.3 yang broken ### Changes Included - GitHub API fallback saat latest.json missing - Manual update mode dengan "Open Download Page" button - CI hardening: createUpdaterArtifacts: true dan verifier .sig assets

commits.message:
fix(updater): recover from missing latest.json and harden CI pipeline

- Add createUpdaterArtifacts: true to both tauri.conf.json and tauri.conf.prod.json
- Add isManualUpdateMode to updater types, store, and API
- Implement GitHub API fallback when latest.json is missing (e.g., v0.3.3 without updater manifest)
- Open browser to release page in manual-update mode for download/install
- Show amber manual-update banner and 'Open Download Page' button in AppPreferences
- Harden release.yml: fail publish step if latest.json or .sig files are missing

Merge pull request #93 from gnoviawan/fix/updater-recovery-and-ci-hardening
